title: Children's ring games and songs: Les Ognons, Twinkle Twinkle
summary: Alice sings 'Les Ognons' used in ring games, and the interviewers ask about Creole songs and songs at weddings.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you know a song called, Como Té Piti?
Como Té Piti? Mm-hmm. I don't remember that.
What about, uh... Les Ognons?
Les Ognons. You know that song? Les Ognons sont à Beaumarché. Oui.
Les Ognons.
C'est les ci, c'est les ça. Ma con-mère tourne le dos. Mm-hmm.
Well, the church used to use that when they were, uh...
Eh?
Played Ring Around. Ring Around.

Oh, that goes with Ring Around the Road. Yeah, that was, you'd hold hands together. Yeah. And all the children, you know, around the neighborhood, children wasn't studying about that one like they do now. They all play Ring Around. Les Ognons. Mm-hmm. Eh... Comment y'appelle les autres chansons Ring Around, là?
Are there any of the songs you sing today and nowadays when you work? What do you sing now? I don't know more. You sing now. I sing now.
Sometimes, sometimes... When I see George look down, you know, then... If something come, then I begin to sing it. Cheer him up.
Mm-hmm. Could you sing a part of a little song like that or even hum it right now to see what it's

like? Sing all kinds. Anything would come to my mind then. Anything. Ah, yes. It was the good old days. Mm-hmm. We think we have it hard now. No, no. Those were the better days. Do you know a song of... I'm going to add it on the tip of my tongue. Mademoiselle Josephine, something a la Rudolphine? I can't think.
Mm-hmm .
Mm-hmm .

Mm-hmm . I think I've heard that myself, but I don't know if it was Ori or what. Blanche Tukat is one Ori sings. Yeah, Blanche Tukat, yeah. It was another one, wasn't it? Yeah, he had one called, the play sings, A La Pa, and one called Creole Boba, which is the same tune as Twinkle Twinkle Little Star. Remember that bit? Oh yeah. Do you know Twinkle Twinkle Little Star? The song in English is Twinkle Twinkle? No. Can you whistle that for our knowledge? Yeah. With the hat? Yeah. Yeah.
That's it, eh? Yeah. Up above the moon so high, up above the world so high. The world so high. Like a diamond in the sky.

Like a diamond in the sky. Well, there are Creole words to that that Ori used to sing. In Creole, but it was something different. He called it Creole Boba. I don't know what it is. I didn't understand it.
I don't know no Creole song.

Me, myself, I don't know. Even so, I didn't know I couldn't sing when I was singing. But, uh… Did they ever sing at weddings? No. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Did they ever sing at weddings? Creole songs at weddings? No.
